title: Art
blurb: Famous paintings, sculptures, artists, and how art is made.

hr.title: Umjetnost
hr.blurb: Slavne slike, skulpture, umjetnici i kako nastaje umjetnost.

questions.q: In which museum does the Mona Lisa hang?
questions.fact: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa. The Louvre is in Paris, France.

hr.q: U kojem muzeju visi Mona Lisa?
hr.fact: Mona Lisu je naslikao Leonardo da Vinci. Louvre je u Parizu, u Francuskoj.

questions.q: True or false: The Mona Lisa is painted on canvas.
questions.fact: It is painted on a panel of poplar wood, which has slowly warped over the centuries.

hr.q: Točno ili netočno: Mona Lisa naslikana je na platnu.
hr.fact: Naslikana je na dasci od topolovine, koja se tijekom stoljeća polako iskrivila.

questions.fact: He painted it in 1889, inspired by the view from his window in Saint-Rémy, France.

hr.fact: Naslikao ju je 1889., nadahnut pogledom s prozora u Saint-Rémyju u Francuskoj.

questions.q: Which museum owns The Starry Night today?
questions.fact: The Starry Night hangs at MoMA in New York City, not in the Netherlands, where Van Gogh was born.

hr.q: Koji muzej danas posjeduje Zvjezdanu noć?
hr.fact: Zvjezdana noć visi u MoMA-i u New Yorku, a ne u Nizozemskoj, gdje je Van Gogh rođen.

questions.q: Michelangelo painted the ceiling of which famous chapel?
questions.fact: He worked on the ceiling for four years, from 1508 to 1512.

hr.q: Strop koje je slavne kapele oslikao Michelangelo?
hr.fact: Na stropu je radio četiri godine, od 1508. do 1512.

questions.q: Which is NOT one of the three primary colors for painters?
questions.fact: Mix blue and yellow paint and you get green, so green is a secondary color.

hr.q: Koja od ovih boja NIJE jedna od tri osnovne boje za slikare?
hr.fact: Pomiješaj plavu i žutu i dobit ćeš zelenu, pa je zelena izvedena boja.

questions.q: Pointillism is a painting style made from many tiny what?
questions.fact: Georges Seurat used dots so small that up close they look separate. From far away, your eyes blend them.

hr.q: Poentilizam je stil slikanja mnoštvom sitnih čega?
hr.fact: Georges Seurat slikao je tako sitnim točkicama da izbliza izgledaju odvojeno. Izdaleka ih oči stapaju.

questions.q: A fresco is a painting made on what?
questions.fact: The paint soaks into the plaster as it dries, so the picture becomes part of the wall itself.

hr.fact: Boja se upija u žbuku dok se suši, pa slika postaje dio samog zida.

questions.q: Who made the famous sculpture The Thinker?
questions.fact: The Thinker shows a man deep in thought, with his chin resting on his hand.

hr.q: Tko je napravio slavnu skulpturu Mislilac?
hr.fact: Mislilac prikazuje čovjeka zadubljenog u misli, s bradom naslonjenom na ruku.

questions.q: Painter Frida Kahlo came from which country?
questions.fact: Kahlo is famous for colorful self-portraits, often with flowers, monkeys, or parrots.

hr.q: Iz koje je zemlje bila slikarica Frida Kahlo?
hr.fact: Kahlo je poznata po šarenim autoportretima, često s cvijećem, majmunima ili papigama.
